# bugs #4250: return of a struct member such as w.in gives an internal error for stm8 and z80 and wrong bytes for mcs51

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/bugs/4250/
- Category: [Duplicates](../../duplicate.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17193
- Recommended action: Close as a duplicate of bug #3849. The patch for #3849 in this report is for the statements of this ticket.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

For the file of the ticket, r17193 stops with the internal error and SIGSEGV of the report. The
error is at line 2780 of `src/stm8/gen.c` with `-mstm8` and at line 6432 of `src/z80/gen.c` with
`-mz80`.

For mcs51, r17193 compiles the file without a diagnostic, as the reporter writes, and the code is
wrong. A program with the function of the ticket and a caller that stores the result was run in
ucsim. The member has the bytes 0x5a and 0xa5, and the caller gets 0x00 and 0x00. The caller gets
these bytes in the four models and with `--stack-auto` in the small and large models.

The ticket also lists `return *p;`, `return u.s;`, and `return *(S2*)&tmp;` for stm8. These
statements were not run.

## Reason

Bug #3849 is open and has the same cause. The front end gives the `RETURN` iCode a struct or union
object as its operand only when the expression is a variable. For `w.in` and the other expressions
of this ticket the operand is an address, and the code generators do not have code that returns a
struct from an address. The function of #3849 returns `*((struct Test *)(&arg))`, which has the
form of the last statement above.

In the first comment the reporter writes that the operand gets its pointer type in `replaceRegEqv`
of `src/SDCCopt.c`, in the loop that converts operands of struct and union type to pointers. The
patch for #3849 in this report does not change that loop. Its `geniCodeReturnStruct` in
`src/SDCCicode.c` copies the value to a temporary object and gives `RETURN` that object, so the
operand is an object as it is for a variable. The test of the patch has `return gw.m;` with a
member of struct type, `return *p;` for a struct and for a union, and the function of #3849.

With the whole series of this report applied, the caller in the mcs51 program gets 0x5a and 0xa5
in the six configurations, and the file of the ticket compiles for stm8 and z80. The program was
not run with the patch for #3849 alone.

## Related

- #4131 has the internal error for `return c ? a : b;` with struct operands. Its tenth comment
  names this ticket.
- #3847 has the same cause for calls, and #4157 reports the defect for mcs51.
